prototype.message: Developer preview · Browser installers and security review are not complete.

containerHelp.message: Keep accounts in separate spaces. This does not hide your IP address. Your current tab stays open.

videoHelp.message: Speed control for accessible main-document and iframe video/audio. Protected Firefox pages and inaccessible players are excluded.

subtitleHelp.message: Choose original and translated VTT or SRT files. Captions follow video time and stay on your device. This tool does not automatically translate files.

translationHelp.message: Bring selected text or the current caption line here. Review the text before sending. Selectable text in page popups also works.

sourceText.message: Text to send · up to 5,000 characters

noProvider.message: No translation service selected. Add a trusted service in Settings → Translation. No text has been sent to a service.

progressHelp.message: 3 discoveries: create or open a container, apply a video speed, and save text to your vocabulary. Each action counts once; taking a break keeps your progress.

localScope.message: Saved on this device in this browser profile.

languageScope.message: Language selection applies to the extension’s Aion screens. Change Firefox’s own language in Firefox Settings.

fontHelp.message: OpenDyslexic and Lexend offer alternatives for different reading preferences, with Turkish character support. Choose whichever feels most comfortable.

previewText.message: Learn, explore, browse freely. Turkish characters: Çç Ğğ Iı İi Öö Şş Üü. Your settings apply immediately.

appearanceScope.message: Scale, font and text size apply to Aion surfaces. The Firefox toolbar can receive the color theme; its native font and scale cannot be changed by an extension.

nativeTranslation.message: Firefox’s built-in page translation is preserved and runs on-device for supported languages. Aion selected-text translation uses the optional service below.

targetLanguage.message: Translation target language · depends on service support

endpointHelp.message: Choose your own LibreTranslate-compatible HTTPS endpoint. Content blocking already requires all-site access; saving here explicitly selects this service. Text is sent only when you press Translate. Services requiring API keys are not supported.

silentFeedback.message: Feedback in this version is silent and static. Your system’s reduced-motion preference is always respected.

confirmResetProgress.message: Discovery progress will be reset. Containers and vocabulary will be kept. Continue?

dataHelp.message: Backup includes Aion settings, words, draft, site appearance/speed rules and game record. It may contain private data. Model files and custom character PNGs are separate; use character export for those.

confirmImport.message: Aion settings, vocabulary and progress will be replaced with the backup. Download your current backup first if needed. The translation endpoint stays unchanged. Continue?

updateHelp.message: Checks this extension’s published releases, including developer previews. Permanent installation and automatic updates require Mozilla signing and a distribution channel. Firefox manages browser updates.

noRelease.message: No stable browser release has been published yet.

securityNote.message: No browser can guarantee protection from every infection. Security requires an updated engine and verified distribution.

opened.message: Page opened in a new container tab.

selectionRead.message: Text captured. Review it before sending.

translating.message: Sending your chosen text to the translation service…

wordSaved.message: Saved to vocabulary. Duplicate text is not added twice.

restrictedPage.message: This page cannot be accessed. Open a regular HTTP or HTTPS tab and try again.

unauthorized.message: This action must be started from the Aion panel.

containerMissing.message: Container not found. Reopen the panel and select it again.

noVideo.message: No accessible video was found. Try again in the tab containing the video. Cross-origin embedded players may not be supported.

invalidCaptions.message: Could not read subtitles. Choose a valid VTT or SRT file with timestamps.

chooseSubtitle.message: Choose at least one subtitle file.

noCaptions.message: No caption line is accessible now. Enable video captions and try again, or paste text manually.

textRequired.message: Select or paste text to translate or save.

invalidEndpoint.message: Enter a valid HTTPS endpoint without credentials, query parameters, IP addresses or custom ports.

permissionRequired.message: Translation domain permission was not granted. Enable the service again in Settings.

translationFailed.message: The service could not complete translation. Check the endpoint and target language support, then retry.

updateFailed.message: Could not reach GitHub. Check your connection and retry; other features remain available.

fileTooLarge.message: File is too large. Use subtitles up to 2 MB or backups up to 3 MB.

invalidBackup.message: This is not a supported Aion backup. Choose a version 1 JSON backup.

operationFailed.message: The action could not be completed. Retry on a regular web tab; for translation, check your connection and service settings.

tabLayoutHelp.message: Place tabs at the top, left or right. Your choice is saved in this profile and applies to open windows.

temporaryHelp.message: The container and its site data are removed when its last tab closes. Downloads and browsing history are not deleted.

qualityHelp.message: The first quality adapter targets YouTube and may be affected by site changes. Quality forcing on Netflix and other services is not supported yet. Account, DRM and device limits apply. Your preference is saved; apply it to each video with the button in this preview.

resolutionUnknown.message: Resolution is not available yet. Start the video and try again.

unsupportedQuality.message: Quality selection is not supported on this player. Use the site’s own quality menu.

unavailableQuality.message: This player does not offer the requested quality. Choose another quality or highest available.

qualityRequested.message: Quality preference sent to the player. Check the result with actual resolution; the player may override the request.

unsupportedSpeed.message: This video source does not accept speed changes. Live media streams may have a fixed playback rate.

customizationHelp.message: Drag buttons, the search box and spacers in the built-in editor to add, remove or rearrange them. Restore the default layout from that editor.

websiteThemeAuto.message: Follow browser theme · preserve site design

websiteThemeHelp.message: Site colors and your saved site theme are left untouched. Only sites that ask for your browser color preference use this choice. The default dark browser reports a dark preference. Pages are not forcibly recolored.

browserFontHelp.message: Applies to toolbars, tab labels and native settings. Website fonts are preserved. Aion panel text settings can be adjusted separately.

imageSearchHelp.message: Right-click an image and choose Google Lens, Bing, TinEye or Yandex. The image URL is sent to your chosen search service only when you select it.

characterScope.message: An optional local sidebar. It does not add characters to webpages or send character files to a server.

characterPreview.message: Frame animation of the selected character

characterReduced.message: Reduced motion is enabled; the character stays still.

characterImportHelp.message: Choose a PNG image or an exported character file. Up to 8 custom characters stay in this profile. Use the separate export button to back up a character.

characterGridHelp.message: For a still image, leave columns and rows at 1. For a sprite sheet, enter its columns/rows, the row to play and its frame count. PNG files can be up to 6 MB.

characterDeleteConfirm.message: Remove this custom character from this profile?

characterTooLarge.message: Choose a smaller PNG: up to 6 MB, 8192 pixels per side and 16 million pixels total.

characterInvalid.message: Choose a valid PNG or Fire Axolotl character backup.

characterAnimatedPNG.message: This file is APNG. Use a regular PNG sprite sheet so animation can be paused.

characterGridInvalid.message: Check the sprite grid: use 1–16 columns/rows, no more frames than columns, and equally divisible image dimensions.

characterStorageFailed.message: The character could not be loaded or saved. Reopen the panel and try again.

characterLibraryFull.message: The 8-character limit is reached. Export and remove one before adding another.

newtabGame.message: Show Aion Run on new tabs

newtabGameHelp.message: A small offline game. Starts only when you press Start. Hide it at any time; search and shortcuts stay available. Changes apply to new tabs.

extensionWelcome.message: One Firefox extension: Aion and tools on this device.

browserTheme.message: Apply the Aion theme to the Firefox toolbar

enableRunner.message: Show Aion Run on the extension new tab

blockerHelp.message: This single extension includes the uBlock Origin 1.76.0 engine. Open its panel for lists, site exceptions and blocking controls. This is an independent combined distribution.

noTabs.message: No open tabs match this search.

sidebarScope.message: Place the Firefox sidebar on either side using Firefox sidebar settings. Firefox controls the top tab strip. Reopen a closed tab with Ctrl+Shift+T.

searchFirefox.message: Search with the Firefox default search engine

newtabScope.message: This is the extension new tab. Search uses your Firefox default search engine. The game and record work offline.

pageDarkHelp.message: Dark Reader is applied explicitly to the chosen main document. Without Remember it resets on reload. Restore appearance also removes this site’s saved rule. Protected Firefox pages are excluded. Browser theme and page font are separate preferences.

qrHelp.message: Text or an address becomes a QR code on this device, without sending it to a service. Up to 1000 characters.

qrText.message: Text to encode as a QR code

aiLocalHelp.message: Text is processed on this device, without sending it to an AI server. Choose packaged Bergamot for English↔Turkish, M2M100 for other languages and Qwen for general text. Results can contain errors.

aiModelSize.message: Bergamot EN ↔ TR model data is packaged (~44 MB). Qwen CPU needs ~1.59 GB / WebGPU ~1.23 GB; M2M100 needs ~0.64 GB as a separate download/import. One engine is kept in memory at a time.

aiImportHelp.message: Select the five JSON files and ONNX files of the chosen pinned model. Qwen needs one model file; M2M100 needs encoder_model_quantized.onnx and decoder_model_merged_quantized.onnx. Files are SHA-256 verified.

aiImport.message: Verify and load local model files

aiConfirmDelete.message: Delete the selected model files? Aion settings, vocabulary and game record will be kept.

aiGeneral.message: Ask the same model another question

aiGeneralHelp.message: This shared local engine can support future features. Here it only sees what you type; it cannot read tabs or take actions. Responses may contain errors.

aiVideoHelp.message: Choose source and target languages above. The loaded local model translates readable video captions or local VTT/SRT files. Original and translation share the same timestamps.

aiLiveLimit.message: Experimental: requires player captions exposed as browser text tracks. Custom players such as YouTube/Netflix may not expose them. It does not transcribe audio; no speech-recognition model is included. Translation can lag; pretranslate a subtitle file for more consistent timing.

aiState-unloaded.message: Model is not loaded. Download, select offline files, or load an existing cached model.

aiState-downloading.message: Model files are being verified and saved on this device.

aiState-loading.message: Preparing the local runtime and model. This may take several minutes for a large model.

aiState-ready.message: Local model ready · running on this device

aiState-running.message: The local model is generating on this device. You can cancel.

aiState-error.message: Model preparation failed. Check local files, free storage and available memory, then retry.

aiModelMissing.message: Local model is not ready. Download it or load the correct offline files first.

aiGPUUnavailable.message: This Firefox/device does not provide WebGPU with shader-f16. Choose CPU / WASM.

aiImportMissing.message: Model files are missing. Select all files listed in the instructions.

aiDownloadFailed.message: A model file could not be downloaded, verified or saved. Check connectivity, free space and file revision, then retry.

aiHashMismatch.message: Model revision or SHA-256 does not match. Use the correct file from the pinned revision.

aiBusy.message: The local model is busy. Wait for completion or cancel the operation.

aiCancelled.message: Local operation cancelled. Completed model files are retained.

aiRuntimeFailed.message: Local runtime failed on this device. Check available memory and Firefox version, or try the other backend.

aiInferenceFailed.message: The model produced no usable response. Retry with shorter text.

aiVideoActive.message: Dual captions enabled. Translation is processed on this device.

aiWaitingCaption.message: Waiting for a readable caption. Play the video and select a subtitle track.

aiNoReadableCaptions.message: No readable captions are exposed by the player. Enable player captions or choose a VTT/SRT file.

firefoxControls.message: Firefox tab layout, languages and account

firefoxControlsHelp.message: Use Firefox’s built-in tab/sidebar settings to choose top or vertical tabs and the sidebar side. An extension cannot rewrite the native tab strip, fonts, language packs or account/Sync screens. Firefox manages these settings.

moduleLayoutHelp.message: Disable unused tools and reorder popup sections with Move up/down. Blocking has its own dashboard; image search and the game have separate switches.

moduleDisabled.message: This tool is disabled. Enable it in Settings → Tools to use it.

syncScope.message: Uses Firefox storage.sync; Firefox manages your account and Sync connection. Only language, appearance, tool order and caption preferences are sent. Words, drafts, model, cookies, site addresses and service endpoint are excluded. Each transfer requires a button press. The item stays below 8 KB; Firefox quotas/connectivity apply.

syncPush.message: Send this device’s preferences to Sync

syncPull.message: Apply synced preferences on this device

openFirefoxSync.message: Open Firefox account and Sync settings

syncTooLarge.message: Preferences exceed the Sync item quota. Use a local JSON backup.

syncEmpty.message: No synced preferences exist for this extension. Send them from a device first.

syncSaved.message: Preferences saved to Firefox storage.sync. Delivery to another device depends on Firefox Sync connectivity.

syncRestored.message: Synced preferences applied; local content preserved.

rememberSiteStyle.message: Remember color and font preferences for this site on this device

applySiteFont.message: Apply only the page text font

siteRuleLimit.message: Up to 200 site preferences can be stored. Reset an old site preference and retry.

rememberSpeed.message: Remember this site’s speed on this device

speedShortcuts.message: Supports video and audio. In Firefox → Add-ons → gear menu → Manage Extension Shortcuts, assign increase/decrease/reset speed shortcuts.

aiM2MHelp.message: M2M100 is for translation and needs a separate approximately 640 MB CPU download. Choose Qwen for general prompts. Select the source language manually if detection is uncertain. Translations can change meaning or tense; review the result.

aiSourceRequired.message: Language could not be detected reliably. Select the source language manually.

aiTargetUnsupported.message: The selected target language is not supported by this model.

aiBackendHelp.message: Reload the model to apply a changed backend; the ready status shows the active backend.

captionOffsetHelp.message: Positive values delay both tracks; negative values show them earlier. This affects playback only; exported VTT timestamps stay unchanged.

captionStudyHelp.message: Playback is paused. Choose a word or the sentence, then translate or save it.

captionStudyText.message: Word or sentence to save · up to 300 characters

captionBoundary.message: No further caption line in this direction.

captionSeekUnavailable.message: This player cannot seek to the selected caption.

captionPositioned.message: Moved to the caption; start playback in the player.

restoreTabPrivacy.message: Restore requests Firefox’s optional sessions permission only when clicked. The closed-tab list is not stored by the extension or sent to a server.

noClosedTab.message: There is no recent closed tab to restore.

pageTranslationHelp.message: Review the page text first, then translate and apply using the selected local model. Source and target use the language choices above. Text is not sent to a translation server.

pageScopePage.message: Rendered text in the main document

pageTranslationLimits.message: Up to 40 text fragments / 12,000 characters per scan, at most 1,000 per fragment. Form fields, editable areas, code, hidden text and frames are skipped. Scanning again first restores the previous application. Text changed by the website is never overwritten. Firefox system pages are unsupported; translations may be wrong.

pageTranslate.message: Translate previewed text locally and apply

pageScanLimited.message: Some text was skipped because of limits

pageScanExpired.message: The document or scan changed; preview again.

pageScanRequired.message: Preview the target page text first.

captionNativeForLive.message: Choose the player’s caption track for live translation; use file translation for imported captions.

captionLooping.message: Line loop started. You can pause the video; seeking outside the line ends the loop.

aiBergamotHelp.message: Bergamot English ↔ Turkish: the engine and about 44 MB of model data are inside this extension; no download or account is needed. Translations can be wrong, especially idioms. Choose M2M100 for other languages and Qwen for general prompts.

aiBergamotPairUnsupported.message: Packaged Bergamot supports English and Turkish only. Change the source/target language or choose M2M100.

aiTextTooLong.message: Text for the local model must be at most 4,000 characters.

aiSourceText.message: Text to translate · up to 4,000 characters

aiQwenHelp.message: Qwen 2.5 1.5B is separately loaded for general text tasks. Its Turkish translation check produced a wrong result; Bergamot/M2M100 are other translation choices. This model has no browser tools.

captionStudyLocal.message: Uses your local AI engine. Short words may need an explicit source language. Translations can be wrong. Escape closes this card and keeps the video paused.

wordbookHelp.message: Manage the words and sentences you saved from subtitles and translation.

wordbookScope.message: This vocabulary stays in this Firefox profile. It is not automatically sent to the cloud or AI. Imports preserve existing entries.

wordbookEmpty.message: No entries yet. Add a word below or from a subtitle card.

wordNoMatches.message: No entries match your search. Try another search.

wordRemoved.message: Entry removed. You can undo the last removal.

wordUndoHelp.message: Removals can be undone. Undo for the last removal is available while this page stays open.

wordUndoExpired.message: This removal can no longer be undone. Add the word again or merge a backup.

wordMissing.message: This entry was removed in another page. Try again after the list updates.

wordSource.message: Source text to save · up to 300 characters

wordTooLong.message: You can save up to 300 characters. Shorten the text and try again.

wordLimit.message: Vocabulary is full: 5,000 entries. Remove an entry from Vocabulary to make space. Existing entries are preserved.

wordAddDisabled.message: Adding words is disabled because Translation is turned off. You can still search, remove and back up your entries.

wordBackupHelp.message: Export only vocabulary as JSON. Preview before importing; merging keeps existing words and skips duplicates. Limit: 5,000 entries, 300 characters per entry and a 12 MiB file. Settings, translation endpoints and drafts are excluded.

wordImportReady.message: Preview ready. No entries have been changed yet.

invalidWordBackup.message: This is not a valid Fire Axolotl vocabulary backup. Check the JSON format, version and entry limits. Existing entries were not changed.

wordPreviewLimit.message: The latest 50 entries appear below. Open Vocabulary to search or remove entries.

wordFileTooLarge.message: Vocabulary backups can be up to 12 MiB. Existing entries were not changed.

panelWelcome.message: What would you like to do? Translate here or open the full-size workspace.

panelTargetHelp.message: Video, selected text and container actions use this website tab. Opening the panel preserves its source tab.

panelTranslationHelp.message: Type text or read your website selection. Choose the source/target languages, then Translate on device. Built-in English ↔ Turkish needs no account or model download.

panelPackagedReady.message: Ready: English ↔ Turkish is included. It starts on your first Translate click.

panelModelNeedsLoad.message: Start the selected model on the AI screen first. Choose Bergamot for the included translator.

panelAIHelp.message: Built-in translation and Qwen are separate choices. Both process text on your device during inference. Qwen model files are a separate download.

panelAIStepOne.message: Quick translation: Open built-in translator → Start translation → type text. English ↔ Turkish is already included.

panelAIStepTwo.message: Ask Qwen: Open Qwen → Download and run model → type in General questions. The first CPU download is about 1.59 GB.

panelAIStepThree.message: Video: enable the player’s subtitles → Translate video subtitles → choose tab/languages → turn on subtitle translation.

containerSimpleHelp.message: Containers keep website sessions separate. For example, sign into Work and Personal accounts on the same site at the same time. Your Firefox data and original tab stay in place.

containerStepOne.message: Choose a name or create a container such as Work / Personal.

containerStepTwo.message: Open in this container: the site opens in a new colored tab. Sign into the account you want there.

containerStepThree.message: Shortcut: right-click a page, link or tab → Aion · Open in container → choose its name.

targetTabMissing.message: The source tab is closed. Choose another website tab.

aiGuideHelp.message: English ↔ Turkish is included. Start it with the button below. To ask Qwen questions, select Qwen in the model list and download it once; files stay on this device.

aiGuideOne.message: Start the included translator. It can start even while offline.

aiGuideTwo.message: Under Translate text, choose source/target languages, type text and press Translate with local model.

aiGuideThree.message: For video, use Translate video subtitles below, choose its tab and enable the player’s subtitles. Some sites do not expose their subtitles.
